sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 10163053 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2026 season as published: 'Open May 19, 2026 - September 15, 2026.' The dates shift a few days each year (rec.gov peak-season rates run 2027-05-25 to 2027-09-14).

Single site $15 per night; $5 per extra vehicle beyond the 2 allowed per site. FCFS sites pay cash, check or Scan & Pay on the Recreation.gov app ($1.50 service fee, one night at a time). Only Senior and Access passes apply to camping fees.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/sloway-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Extra Vehicle Fee: $5 per additional vehicle(s) (after two vehicles)', 'Cost is $15.00 per site with a $1.50 service fee', 'only Senior and Access Passes can be used for camping fees') + recreation.gov /rates (all site types $15, peak seasons 2024-2027), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/sloway-campground ('please note that only Senior and Access Passes can be used for camping fees'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations are needed for sites 1-10 and 21-25; sites 11-20 and 26-27 are first-come, first-served (the Forest Service page; recreation.gov's notice says sites 21-27 are reservable). The equestrian site is reservable. Maximum stay 16 days per reservation.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/sloway-campground ('Reservations are needed for sites 1 - 10 and 21 - 25', 'Sites 11- 20 and 26 & 27 are first-come, first-serve') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10163053 (notice 'The maximum stay limit is 16 days per reservation'; rule maxConsecutiveStay 16), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 27 sites (the Forest Service parking section says 28, counting the equestrian site; recreation.gov's catalog lists 28 including one group site and the equestrian site), 12 of them pull-throughs for vehicles longer than 35 ft. No per-site lengths in the catalog.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10163053 ('There are 27 sites in total with 12 pull-through sites for vehicles longer than 35 feet') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/sloway-campground ('The paved campground has 27 sites total'; Parking: 'There are 28 sites in total with 12 pull-through sites') + recreation.gov per-site catalog, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for facility 10163053 (all 28 sites typed NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/sloway-campground ('Sloway Campground is paved and has vault toilets, potable water, a Camp Host, and trash services'), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF (Superior Ranger District), ~7 mi E of St. Regis off I-90 on the Clark Fork River; paved, in the shade of pines, with a primitive boat launch, camp hosts and an equestrian site with corral. Significant I-90 and train noise. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Superior RD, camp hosts; no concessionaire named). Confirmed $15, reservable on rec.gov with some FCFS sites, 27 sites with 12 pull-throughs, no electric/water hookups, vault toilets + potable water. Added season May 19-Sep 15 (2026), 16-night max, $5 extra vehicle, Senior/Access pass. Not stated: max rig length, window (left inherited). No alerts for the campground or its access road.
